## Context / Problem
Eighteen external-test files contain repeated, historical, decorative, or code-restating prose. Their scope is revalidated on `origin/main` at `0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`; one intervening comment change is outside the reviewed blocks.

## Approach
Condense only the listed blocks. Preserve non-docstring AST, runtime prompts/fixtures/reasons, markers, model/provider constants, cleanup order, raw-source sentinel behavior, and exact directives.

## Scope
- `_live_llm.py:1-31,54-59,76-85,140-151,183-191` — Preserve configured-provider readiness, family translation, class/overlay resolution, credentials, pinned-arm matching, visible skips, and deliberate region exclusion.
- `_structured_matrix.py:1-17` — Preserve network-free scorer, call-budget/matrix-cell core, and production parser reuse.
- `conftest.py:27-39,63-69,122-127,147-155,165-177,196-201,215-224,233-238` — Preserve opt-in/execution canary, marker lanes, all-skip failure, inert defaults, temporary model enablement/restoration, commit-backed scratch repo/prompt overrides, and deterministic plan floor.
- `test_bedrock_cache_live.py:1-19` and `test_candidate_tracing_live.py:1-21` — Preserve opt-ins, ambient AWS repeated-prefix cache oracle, and real OTel nesting with mocked network-free model transport.
- `test_completion_banking_behavior_0707.py:1-22,49-52,149-154` — Preserve evidence-response denomination, actor-agnostic bounded banking, local read-only verification, provider pin/readiness, and broad immutable workload.
- `test_completion_pass_live.py:1-12`, `test_deps_live.py:1-11`, and `test_execution_mode_live.py:1-12` — Preserve configured-provider routing and their PASS-sidecar, deps.dev result, and single-turn structured oracles.
- `test_link_sync_live.py:1-22,101,105,109,129,134,147,153` — Preserve client-primitive Jira shape, gating/cleanup, A-blocks-B orientation, diagnostics, deletion, and 404-idempotent cleanup while deleting code restatements.
- `test_link_sync_roundtrip_live.py:1-38,78-86,303-309,396-415,444-456,459-465,477-488` — Preserve live differ/apply/dedup/inbound coverage, import path, authoritative Jira read, absolute relationship direction, intentional local-apply exclusion, safe issue cleanup, and anti-agreement oracle.
- `test_llm_trace.py:1-22,131-135,143-146` — Preserve OTLP export/flush/polling, Langfuse gating, `review_code` as findings vehicle, and genuinely new trace selection.
- `test_model_requests_enabled.py:1-11` — Preserve external-tier re-enablement of model requests.
- `test_provider_matrix_live.py:1-26,56-67,109-115,131-139` — Preserve realized family, scalar-`cfg.model` second path, sole nonblank declared-provider credential, empty-as-absent rule, Bedrock region variables, CI-only activation, and canary.
- `test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py:1-29,69-79` — Preserve forced runner coverage, provider-parametric models, frontier review path, parameter compatibility, and provenance.
- `test_reconcile_live.py:1-20`, `test_review_discovery_live.py:1-16`, and `test_review_kernel_rules_live.py:1-21` — Preserve live preview/no-mutation boundary, narrow discovery verdict/internal journal/log boundary, and independent/allow-insufficient live rule behavior.

Consumers include external conftest, both external workflow lanes, structured-output workflow, unit source scanners/scorers, Jira pressure probes, hermetic contract counterparts, and documentation. No targeted `__doc__` reader exists. Preserve all listed `noqa` and `type: ignore` directives attached to the same statements. Do not introduce bare `live_llm_ready()` text into provider-pinned modules.
## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Only reviewed comments/true docstrings or blank lines change; normalized non-docstring AST, runtime strings, assertions, and exact statement-attached directives remain unchanged.
- [x] An independent reviewer posts a leaf-linked TSV with one row per edited block, pinned before and immutable final-commit after citations, preserved contract/consumer, before/after words, and `semantic-preservation` plus `bloat-removal` verdicts.
- [x] Every edited block is shorter and removes repetition/history/ornament rather than relocating it; every TSV row is PASS.
- [x] Recorded focused hermetic checks, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv scoped checks and Gerrit CI pass.
- [x] Missing/FAIL rows or unmatched diff hunks block closure.

## Verification
Run the recorded normalized AST/directive guard, focused tests, diff check, and scoped lint/typecheck checks; Gerrit CI supplies the full suite. The independent TSV judges prose quality.
